questions.q: If $\vec A=\hat i+\hat j$ and $\vec B=\hat j+\hat k$, what is $|\vec A\times\vec B|$?
questions.e: $\vec A\times\vec B=\hat i-\hat j+\hat k$, whose magnitude is $\sqrt3$.

questions.q: Two vectors have magnitudes 3 and 4. Which of the following CANNOT be the magnitude of their sum?
questions.e: The magnitude of the sum ranges from $|A-B|$ to $A+B$, i.e. from 1 to 7.

questions.q: For arbitrary $\vec A$ and $\vec B$, what is $\vec A\cdot(\vec A\times\vec B)$?
questions.e: $\vec A\times\vec B$ is perpendicular to $\vec A$, so the dot product is zero.
